name: Button Auction
summary: An ascending-clock auction where bidders hold a button until the price exceeds their valuation; last holder wins.
rules_text: A single item is auctioned to N bidders, each with a private valuation. The auctioneer starts at a low price and raises it in fixed increments at regular intervals. While the price is below their valuation, bidders must keep their button pressed. If the current price exceeds what a bidder is willing to pay, that bidder must irrevocably release the button and is eliminated. Bidders observe how many others remain but not others' valuations. The clock continues rising until only one bidder remains with button pressed. That bidder wins the item and pays the current price at which the last opponent dropped out.
rating_reason: Specific auction game with private values and elimination
